incident.symptom: The availability drill shows no fired alerts after its threshold was raised to two.
observations: The enabled rule reports Backend: wordpress-pool~wordpress-http.
Application Gateway sends live WordPress traffic to wordpress-aks-pool.
The WordPress readiness URL responds successfully.

incident.symptom: A temporary Key Vault test pod is scheduled, but its container never starts.
observations: Kubelet reports mkdirat on /run/secrets/kubernetes.io: read-only file system.
The failing mount is the projected Kubernetes service-account volume.
The test container mounted a Key Vault CSI volume read-only at /run/secrets.

incident.symptom: A fresh Terraform plan exits before planning any resources.
observations: The error says the state blob is already locked.
Lock information says OperationTypePlan and names the same workstation.
The previous terminal was closed after interrupting an input prompt.

incident.symptom: Terraform cannot create the Azure Monitor email action group.
observations: The error specifies the microsoft.insights namespace.
The resource group and Application Gateway already exist.

incident.symptom: Terraform cannot add the WordPress web-stack extension to the running VM scale set.
observations: The VMSS extension request fails with HTTP 400 InvalidParameter.
Azure says forceUpdateTag cannot exceed 50 characters.
The Terraform plan shows a full SHA-256 hash for force_update_tag.
